# 借鉴已验证的 AI SEO 策略

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2025-06-23 14:07（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/1937029642042388907
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

@mattdiggityseo 2. 借鉴 @fatjoedavis 已经验证有效的 AI SEO 策略：
https://x.com/fatjoedavies/status/1936029378476994617

### 原帖中的引用预览（非被引用文章全文）

[Joe Davies @fatjoedavies](<https://x.com/fatjoedavies/status/1936029378476994617>)

这就是我完整的 AI SEO（GEO/AIO）策略。你一定会觉得完全陌生：

- 建设反向链接、引用和品牌提及
- 鼓励真实评价，并争取进入“最佳”榜单文章
- 入驻多个评价平台
- 提供出色的服务和产品，让人们在论坛、Reddit、Quora 和社交媒体上正面讨论我的品牌
- 拥有独特卖点（USP），并因这个独特卖点而被人记住，成为某类人群或客户画像的首选
- 针对客户正在搜索的查询优化内容
- 确保网站用户体验出色、技术可靠、速度快

我知道，这些都是完全全新的事情，以前从来没人做过。但相信我，它似乎确实有效。

## 英文原文

@mattdiggityseo 2. Steal @fatjoedavis’ proven AI SEO strategy:
https://x.com/fatjoedavies/status/1936029378476994617

### Quoted preview

[Joe Davies @fatjoedavies](<https://x.com/fatjoedavies/status/1936029378476994617>)

Here is my EXACT AI SEO (GEO/AIO) strategy. This will not be at all familiar:

- Build backlinks, citations and brand mentions
- Encourage honest reviews and inclusion in best of listicles
- Get listed on multiple review platforms
- Provide a great service and offer great products so people talk about my brand in a positive light on forums/reddit/quora/social
- Have a USP, and be known for that USP, the choice for a certain demographic or avatar
- Optimise content for queries my customers are looking for
- Ensure my website UX is great, technically sound, and fast

I know these are all COMPLETE new things and never been done before, but trust me it seems to work.
